title: Doubling and halving
examples: If I have ten sweets, what is half?
Can you share six apples between two friends?

explain.say: Doubling means two equal groups of the same number. You add a number to itself.
Hold up two fingers on each hand. Two and two make four. So double two is four.
Now hold up three fingers on each hand. Double three is six. Double five is ten.
Halving means sharing into two equal groups. Each group gets the same amount.
Share ten counters into two piles. Give one to each pile in turn. Each pile gets five.
Halving undoes doubling. Double five is ten, and half of ten is five.

faq.q: What does it mean to double a number?
faq.a: It means to multiply that number by two. You are making two equal groups of that number.
asks: How do I double this number?

faq.a: You can only halve even numbers perfectly. An even number can be shared equally into two groups.
asks: What if the number is odd?
Is there a number I cannot halve?

faq.q: Is halving the same as dividing by two?
faq.a: Yes, it is exactly the same thing. Halving a number means dividing it by two.
asks: What is the math word for sharing in two?

faq.q: How do I know if a number is even?
faq.a: A number is even if it can be shared equally into two groups. You can check if it ends in zero, two, four, six, or eight.
asks: Are all numbers that end in two even?

faq.q: What is the difference between doubling and halving?
faq.a: Doubling makes two groups of the same number, so the total gets bigger. Halving shares a number into two equal groups, so each group is smaller.
asks: Is doubling the opposite of halving?
If I double and then halve, what happens?

facts: Doubling a number means multiplying it by two.
Halving a number means dividing it by two.
If you double a number and then halve it, you get the original number back.
Only even numbers can be perfectly halved using whole numbers.

quiz.say: Look at the two groups. Tap how many in all.
quiz.why: Four and four make eight. So double four is eight.

wrong.0: Four is one group, but double means two groups of four.
wrong.1: One strawberry was missed, so count each group again.

quiz.say: Share the apples into two equal groups. Tap how many in each.
quiz.why: Each group gets four. Four and four make eight.

wrong.1: Three and three make six, so each group needs one more.
wrong.2: Eight is all the apples, and half is one of two equal groups.

quiz.say: Share 10 stickers between 2 friends. Tap how many each friend gets.
quiz.why: Each friend gets five. Five and five make ten.

wrong.0: Two is the number of friends, and the stickers are what you share.
wrong.2: Ten is all the stickers, so give them out one at a time.
